title.zh: 概率与频率 · 转得越多，越贴近概率
title.en: Probability & Frequency · The More Spins, the Closer to the Probability

desc.zh: 一次转盘结果说不准，但转的次数越多，红色出现的频率就越稳定地围着它的概率打转。
desc.en: One spin cannot be predicted, but with more spins the frequency of red settles ever more steadily around its probability.
